facts.fact: L'Express reports the ministry (MITCI) 'procède aujourd'hui au lancement officiel' of the Digital Transformation Blueprint 2025-2029, a launch presided by the President of the Republic, Dharam Gokhool, with minister Avinash Ramtohul; no cabinet or other adopting act is named.

At the launch the paper says the blueprint's detailed content 'n'est pas encore dévoilé'; the document is described as covering key sectors of society and the economy and aligned with the Government Programme 2025-2029.
